rawContent: 0 Skip to Content Contact Us Open Menu Close Menu Contact Us Open Menu Close Menu Welcome At The Relational Therapy Collective, we believe that meaningful change happens in connection—connection with ourselves, our loved ones, with the people in our lives, and the people who support us. Our practice brings together a diverse team of psychologists, clinical social workers, licensed mental health counselors, marriage and family therapists, professional coaches, and a psychiatric Nurse Practitioner. Each clinician brings a unique blend of training, identity, lived experience, and clinical expertise. Yet we share one common purpose: to offer compassionate, grounded, relationally focused care to everyone we serve.Whether you are seeking support for yourself, your relationship, or your family, this is a space where you will be met with warmth, authenticity, and evidence-based guidance. Our Services Collaborative Care for Complex Families Collaborative care is a team-based coordinated approach where multiple professionals work together to support their clients and family’s complex needs. Learn More Individual Therapy One on One therapy is a collaborative process between client and a mental health therapist, exploring and understanding client’s experiences and how this impacts them and be able to provide meaningful healing and change. Learn More Couples Therapy Couples therapy supports partners who want to strengthen their relationship which could include improving their communication, rebuilding trust, understanding their attachment styles, or deepen their connection. Learn More Family Therapy Family therapy focuses on understand ing each other’s perspectives and emotional needs by improving communication, address and reduce conflicts, heal from transition or trauma and build healthier boundaries and roles. Learn More Parent Coaching and Family Consulting Parent coaching & family consulting helps caregivers understand their children’s needs, navigate parenting challenges, create or restructure ways to strengthen family connections. Learn More Life Coaching Life coaching supports clients in building clarity, confidence, and direction in their personal and professional lives. Sessions are goal-oriented, collaborative, and tailored to each individual’s strengths and values. Learn More Group Therapy/Skills Training Group therapy offers a supportive, welcoming space where several people meet regularly where they can connect with other and learn, practice and grow using the group itself as part of the learning/healing process. Learn More Medication Management For some clients, medication management can be helpful while in collaboration with our providers, focusing on assessing, prescribing and adjusting medication to support emotional and psychological wel-being. Learn More Who We Are We are providers who strive to provide exemplary service with our work, yet unique individuals coming from different personal experiences and training. While we share a relational foundation, our providers are also trained in additional evidenced based treatment interventions such as psychodynamic therapy, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), EMDR, Parent and Life coaching, and more. This allows each clinician to tailor the work to the unique needs, goals, and developmental stage of each client.
